title: "Mean Field Interactive demonstration"
format: html
---

```{python}
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import ipywidgets as widgets
from ipywidgets import interact

def plot_sine_wave(T):
    x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 1000)
    y = np.tanh(4*(1/T)*x)

    fig = go.Figure()

    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=y, mode='lines', name=f"T = {T:.2f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=x, mode='lines', name=f"T = {T:.2f} (x)"))
    
    fig.update_layout(
        title="Interactive Sine Wave",
        xaxis_title=r"$\langle \sigma_i \rangle$",
        yaxis_title=r"$\tanh(4 \beta \langle \sigma_i \rangle)$",
        template="plotly_dark",
        showlegend=True
    )

    fig.show()

interact(plot_sine_wave, T=widgets.FloatSlider(min=0.1, max=10, step=0.1, value=1.0))
